title: Seven-Scheme Watermark Exposure
faculty_request: Primary model must be trained on all seven distinct watermarking schemes (dct_qim, dwt_qim, ss_spatial, fft_ring, nmp_freq, svd_qim, dct_svd).
acceptance_criteria: Strict configuration contains all 7 scheme names and keys in state dict.

title: Validation-Selected Primary Checkpoint
faculty_request: Select final primary model using validation performance only (never test data). Freeze checkpoint.
acceptance_criteria: Exact tensor weight match with runs/seed0/best.pt.

title: Checkpoint Cryptographic & Architectural Integrity
faculty_request: Verify SHA-256 hash (37680cdd...) and 2,466,099 trainable parameters of ForensicNet.
acceptance_criteria: SHA-256 bit-identical match, 0 missing/unexpected keys.

title: Fresh Primary In-Distribution Inference
faculty_request: Perform fresh model inference from raw test images (disable cached test_preds.npz reuse) on held-out COCO test split.
acceptance_criteria: Predictions generated fresh, matching test labels and AUC within 0.005 tol.

title: Benign Post-Processing Evaluation
faculty_request: Evaluate primary model across 11 benign operations (JPEG, noise, blur, brightness, compound).
acceptance_criteria: All 11 benign transform metrics verified.

title: Resolution Invariance Evaluation
faculty_request: Evaluate arbitrary resolution invariance across 128px, 256px, and 384px inputs.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics verified across 3 resolutions.

title: PACS Cross-Domain Generalization
faculty_request: Evaluate PACS 4 domains (Photo, Art, Cartoon, Sketch); resolve 1,600 vs 3,200 sample count discrepancy.
acceptance_criteria: Discrepancy resolved and domain metrics confirmed.

title: Adversarial Robustness Evaluation (PGD-10)
faculty_request: Evaluate gradient-based adversarial evasion (PGD-10 at eps=0.5, 1.0, 2.0 / 255); report vulnerability honestly.
acceptance_criteria: Adversarial evasion confirmed without suppression.

title: Hold-One-Scheme-Out Generalization
faculty_request: Verify hold-one-scheme-out models are kept distinct from 7-scheme primary model.
acceptance_criteria: Holdout checkpoints isolated from primary checkpoint.

title: Independent Multi-Seed Stability
faculty_request: Evaluate 3 independent training runs (Seeds 0, 1, 2) on identical test sources.
acceptance_criteria: Mean 0.8528 and std 0.0024 verified.

title: Distortion-Matched Single Watermark Control
faculty_request: Generate and evaluate single-watermarked samples matched in distortion (MSE ~9.14) to double-watermarked images.
acceptance_criteria: Distortion match MSE 9.14 confirmed; AUC 0.5747 reproduced.

title: Nonlinear Residual & Spectral Baselines
faculty_request: Evaluate Logistic Regression and Random Forest on identical held-out test sources; report paired differences.
acceptance_criteria: Paired delta AUC CIs strictly exclude zero (p < 0.001).

title: Matched-Noise Control Evaluation
faculty_request: Evaluate single-watermarked images + matched Gaussian noise (MSE ~9.13) to isolate structured artifact detection.
acceptance_criteria: Matched noise AUC 0.7296 reproduced.

title: Shortcut Learning Scientific Interpretation
faculty_request: Temper claims: acknowledge perturbation energy accounts for modest detection (0.5747), but structured multi-embedding interference provides dominant signal (0.7296 vs noise, 0.854 vs double).
acceptance_criteria: Classification: SUPPORTED_WITH_QUALIFICATION.

title: TrustMark Zero-Shot Stratified Evaluation
faculty_request: Evaluate zero-shot transfer on TrustMark with stratified negative controls (not easy clean-only).
acceptance_criteria: Stratified negative controls verified; AUC 0.6562 reproduced.

title: TrustMark Supervised Adaptation (15%)
faculty_request: Evaluate supervised adaptation on 15% TrustMark data; clearly distinguish from zero-shot transfer.
acceptance_criteria: Adapted AUC 0.8505 verified.

title: Historical TrustMark Protocol Reconciliation
faculty_request: Reconcile historical values (0.534 4-scheme, 0.696 unstratified, 0.851 adapted, 0.925 earlier adapted).
acceptance_criteria: Historical values reconciled by checkpoint and protocol.

title: StegaStamp Zero-Shot Forensic Detection
faculty_request: Evaluate forensic detection on singly vs doubly watermarked StegaStamp images (not just extraction).
acceptance_criteria: StegaStamp AUC 0.9293 confirmed.

title: Neural Generalization Claims Rigor
faculty_request: Acknowledge zero-shot domain gap on TrustMark (0.0% fixed TPR) and report deployment boundaries honestly.
acceptance_criteria: Zero-shot domain gap reported without omission.

title: Watermark Recovery Criteria Definition
faculty_request: Define explicit bit-accuracy recovery criteria for victim and attacker watermarks.
acceptance_criteria: Bit accuracy formula documented and verified.

title: Four Mutually Exclusive Attack Outcome Categories
faculty_request: Classify every attack into: Dual Survival, Successful Overwrite, Failed Attacker Embedding, Both Unrecoverable.
acceptance_criteria: Counts sum to exactly 500; percentages sum to 100.0%.

title: Dual-Survival Rate Verification (88.7% vs 85.0%)
faculty_request: Verify actual recovery records: resolve historical 88.7% claim vs actual verified 85.0% (425/500).
acceptance_criteria: 425/500 = 85.0% strictly proved; 88.7% reconciled.

title: Category-Specific Forensic Detection Metrics
faculty_request: Report category-specific detection rates, detector scores, and ROC-AUC vs common single controls.
acceptance_criteria: Category metrics verified against common controls.

title: Ownership Forgery vs Collision Mechanics
faculty_request: Distinguish between sequential embedding detection, watermark suppression, and legal ownership forgery.
acceptance_criteria: Distinction clearly articulated in claims audit.

title: 95% Confidence Intervals Across All Metrics
faculty_request: Provide 95% confidence intervals for ROC-AUC, TPR@1%FPR, fixed-threshold TPR, and fixed-threshold FPR.
acceptance_criteria: Zero NaN/Inf, lower <= estimate <= upper.

title: Source-Image Grouped Bootstrap (B >= 2,000)
faculty_request: Resample source images as independent units (B >= 2,000); do not resample dependent positive/negative pairs independently.
acceptance_criteria: B=2000 replicates verified, grouped by source.

title: Strict Operating Threshold Discipline
faculty_request: Validation threshold tau = 1.3394 must remain frozen; separate test ROC TPR@1%FPR from fixed-threshold rates.
acceptance_criteria: No recalibration on test set; both metrics reported.

title: Multi-Seed Standard Deviation Convention
faculty_request: Resolve population vs sample standard deviation for 3 seeds (sample std = 0.0024 vs pop std = 0.0020).
acceptance_criteria: Exact formula and degrees of freedom documented.

title: Paired Bootstrap Baseline Difference Testing
faculty_request: Compare RW-Guard with baselines using paired source-level bootstrap; test delta AUC and low-FPR difference.
acceptance_criteria: Paired difference CIs exclude zero.

title: Validation vs Test FPR Discrepancy Investigation
faculty_request: Investigate shift from 1.00% validation FPR (3/300) to 3.33% test FPR (50/1500); evaluate tail density and KS test.
acceptance_criteria: KS test p=0.55 verified; tail sensitivity explained.

title: Consolidated Statistical Table
faculty_request: Produce one authoritative master table covering all conditions, sample counts, metrics, CIs, thresholds, and checkpoints.
acceptance_criteria: All conditions present with complete counts, CIs, and metrics.

title: Dataset & Source Manifest Reconciliation
faculty_request: Master source manifest with 5,000 COCO sources; prove zero split leakage.
acceptance_criteria: Zero source overlap verified across train, val, and test.

title: Automated Regression Test Suite
faculty_request: Execute complete automated unit and integration regression test suite (22 tests); report exact results.
acceptance_criteria: 22/22 tests passing with exit code 0.

title: Scientific Claim Audit & Reconciliation
faculty_request: Audit all material claims against raw evidence; classify supported vs qualified claims.
acceptance_criteria: All claims classified with rigorous justification.

title: Master PowerShell Verification Entry Point
faculty_request: Create run_rwguard_final_verification.ps1 supporting -Mode Full; execute and verify clean exit.
acceptance_criteria: PowerShell script executes all stages and exits code 0.
